description: Implementation of Dolby output interface with registration, unregistration, and mode management functions within WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: DolbyOutputImplementation
classes.description: Implements the Exchange::Dolby::IOutput interface for Dolby audio output control.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification observer for Dolby output events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification observer for Dolby output events.

methods.name: AtmosMetadata
methods.description: Checks if Atmos metadata is supported (returns unavailable).

methods.name: EnableAtmosOutput
methods.description: Enables or disables Atmos output (returns unavailable).

methods.name: Mode
methods.description: Sets or gets the audio output mode.
